meta.prompt: My Pro plan renews in 3 days, on Nov 18. Show a card with the plan and its price ($12 a month), how much of my storage (68 of 100 GB) and seats (3 of 5) I have used as percentages with bars, a switch to annual billing ($120 a year) that shows the yearly price, the price per month and what I would save compared with paying monthly (in dollars and as a percentage), and Manage plan and Cancel renewal buttons.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Pro plan" "Renews Nov 18 · in 3 days" icon:"workspace_premium" status:"Active" tone:"accent"
  SectionLabel "Usage"
  Text.strong "Storage: 68 of 100 GB (68%)"
  Progress 0.68
  Text.strong "Seats: 3 of 5 (60%)"
  Progress 0.6
  SectionLabel "Billing"
  Segments =billing options:["Monthly","Annual"]
  if billing=="Monthly"
    Details rows:[["Price","$12 a month"]]
  if billing=="Annual"
    Details rows:[["Price","$120 a year"],["Per month","$10"],["You save","$24 a year (17%) vs monthly"]]
  Row gap:10
    ActionButton "Manage plan" tone:"quiet" icon:"tune" -> emit manage_plan
    ActionButton "Cancel renewal" tone:"danger" icon:"cancel" -> emit cancel_renewal
